anthropic.title: The [Compliance API](https://platform.claude.com/docs/en/manage-claude/compliance-api) now returns the text each organization member saved as **Instructions for Claude** in claude.ai and as **Global instructions** in Cowork, in beta for Claude Enterprise organizations.
anthropic.summary: Compliance API 新增返回成员保存的 Claude 指令，面向企业版 beta。

anthropic.title: [Fast mode](https://platform.claude.com/docs/en/build-with-claude/fast-mode) is out of research preview for Claude Opus 5.5, and you no longer need to request access.
anthropic.summary: Claude Opus 5.5 fast mode 退出研究预览，不再需要申请访问。

anthropic.title: [Fast mode](https://platform.claude.com/docs/en/build-with-claude/fast-mode) for Claude Opus 5.5 is now available on [Claude in Microsoft Foundry](https://platform.claude.com/docs/en/build-with-claude/claude-in-microsoft-foundry) for deployments hosted on Azure.
anthropic.summary: Claude Opus 5.5 fast mode 已在 Microsoft Foundry 的 Azure 部署上线。

anthropic.title: We've launched [OpenTelemetry export](https://platform.claude.com/docs/en/manage-claude/opentelemetry) in beta, so you can trace Messages API requests and Claude Managed Agents sessions in your observability backend.
anthropic.summary: OpenTelemetry 导出 beta 上线，支持追踪 Messages API 与 Managed Agents。

anthropic.title: Claude Managed Agents [scheduled deployments](https://platform.claude.com/docs/en/managed-agents/scheduled-deployments) are now available on [Claude Platform on AWS](https://platform.claude.com/docs/en/build-with-claude/claude-platform-on-aws).
anthropic.summary: Managed Agents 定时部署现已支持 Claude Platform on AWS。

anthropic.title: You can now let a Claude Managed Agents agent use [dynamic workflows](https://platform.claude.com/docs/en/managed-agents/multiagent-orchestration#dynamic-workflows), in beta with the `managed-agents-2026-04-01` beta header.
anthropic.summary: Managed Agents 支持动态工作流 beta，可编写多代理程序并后台运行。

anthropic.title: The [Compliance API](https://platform.claude.com/docs/en/manage-claude/compliance-api) chat endpoints now also return chats from the unified Claude experience, in beta for Claude Enterprise organizations, with your existing Compliance Access Key.
anthropic.summary: Compliance API 聊天端点新增返回统一 Claude 体验中的聊天记录。

anthropic.title: The Compliance API can now download Claude Docs documents as Word files, in beta.
anthropic.summary: Compliance API 支持将 Claude Docs 文档下载为 Word 文件，beta。

anthropic.title: We've lowered the price of prompt cache reads on Claude Sonnet 5.5 from $0.20 USD to $0.10 USD per million tokens: 0.05x the base input price instead of 0.1x.
anthropic.summary: Claude Sonnet 5.5 提示词缓存读取价格降至每百万 token 0.10 美元。

anthropic.title: We've launched **Claude Haiku 5.5** (`claude-haiku-5-5`), our most capable model tuned for high-volume and latency-sensitive work.
anthropic.summary: 发布 Claude Haiku 5.5，面向高并发与低延迟场景，支持 1M 上下文。

anthropic.title: Code written for Claude Haiku 4.5 can break on Claude Haiku 5.5.
anthropic.summary: Haiku 5.5 与 Haiku 4.5 存在破坏性差异，需按迁移指南调整调用。

anthropic.title: The Python and TypeScript SDKs now include classes, in beta, for the [browser use tool](https://platform.claude.com/docs/en/agents-and-tools/tool-use/browser-use-tool) and the [computer use tool](https://platform.claude.com/docs/en/agents-and-tools/tool-use/computer-use-tool).
